# Hermes Agency

> Multi-agent orchestration for Hermes Agent. Dashboard, 83-agent staff roster, model sets, Kanban routing, task delegation, and safe operations — backed by the AgentAnycast P2P transport layer.

## Overview

Hermes Agency turns Hermes Agent into a managed agency. Operators interact through a dashboard or CLI to dispatch work to specialized staff agents. The system handles routing, queuing, wake-up attempts, and status tracking automatically.

**Key components:**

- **Dashboard** — web UI for dispatching tasks, viewing agent status, and monitoring Kanban boards
- **Staff Roster** — 83 specialized agents (engineering, design, marketing, operations, and more)
- **Model Sets** — configurable provider/model profiles per agent or role
- **Kanban Routing** — task boards with assignees, statuses, and A2A correlation
- **Task Delegation** — pool-based dispatch with offline queuing and wake attempts
- **Safe Operations** — signed auto-updates, scoped tool access, and transport-layer encryption

## Install

```bash
pip install hermes-agency
```

```bash
hermes agency dashboard
```

## CLI

```bash
hermes agency dashboard                          # Start the dashboard
hermes agency discover <skill>                   # Find agents by skill
hermes agency send <target> "<message>"           # Send a task
hermes agency status                              # Check node status
hermes agency info                                # Show PeerID, DID, version
```

## Transport Layer

The AgentAnycast SDK (`src/agentanycast/`) provides the P2P transport beneath Hermes Agency. It handles peer discovery, E2E-encrypted messaging (Noise_XX), relay connectivity, and offline queuing. Operators rarely interact with it directly.

```bash
pip install agentanycast               # Core SDK
pip install agentanycast[crewai]       # + CrewAI adapter
pip install agentanycast[langgraph]    # + LangGraph adapter
pip install agentanycast[adk]          # + Google ADK adapter
pip install agentanycast[openai-agents] # + OpenAI Agents adapter
pip install agentanycast[claude]       # + Claude Agent SDK adapter
pip install agentanycast[strands]      # + AWS Strands adapter
pip install agentanycast[mcp]          # + MCP Server
pip install agentanycast[adapters]     # All adapters
```

## Node — Transport API

```python
from agentanycast import Node, AgentCard, Skill

card = AgentCard(
    name="MyAgent",
    description="Helpful assistant",
    skills=[Skill(id="qa", description="Answer questions")],
)

async with Node(card=card, relay="<relay-multiaddr>") as node:
    @node.on_task
    async def handle(task):
        text = task.messages[-1].parts[0].text
        await task.update_status("working")
        await task.complete(artifacts=[{"parts": [{"text": f"Answer: {text}"}]}])

    await node.serve_forever()
```

## AgentCard and Skill

```python
from agentanycast import AgentCard, Skill

skill = Skill(
    id="translate",
    description="Translate text between languages",
    input_schema='{"type": "object", "properties": {"text": {"type": "string"}}}',
    output_schema='{"type": "object", "properties": {"result": {"type": "string"}}}',
)
card = AgentCard(name="Translator", version="1.0.0", skills=[skill])
```

## Three send_task Modes

```python
msg = {"role": "user", "parts": [{"text": "Hello"}]}

# Direct — known peer
handle = await node.send_task(msg, peer_id="<peer-id>")

# Anycast — skill-based routing via relay registry
handle = await node.send_task(msg, skill="translate")

# HTTP Bridge — standard HTTP A2A endpoint
handle = await node.send_task(msg, url="https://agent.example.com")
```

## TaskHandle — Client-Side API

```python
handle = await node.send_task(msg, skill="translate")
result = await handle.wait()
print(handle.status)
print(handle.artifacts[0].parts[0].text)
await handle.cancel()
```

## Discovery

```python
agents = await node.discover("translate", tags={"lang": "en"}, limit=10)
for agent in agents:
    print(agent["peer_id"], agent["agent_name"])
```

## Framework Adapters

```python
from agentanycast.adapters.crewai import serve_crew
from agentanycast.adapters.langgraph import serve_graph
from agentanycast.adapters.adk import serve_adk_agent
from agentanycast.adapters.openai_agents import serve_openai_agent
from agentanycast.adapters.claude_agent import serve_claude_agent
from agentanycast.adapters.strands import serve_strands_agent
```

## MCP Server

```bash
agentanycast mcp                     # stdio mode (Claude Desktop, Cursor)
agentanycast mcp --transport http    # HTTP mode (ChatGPT, remote)
```

Available MCP tools: `discover_agents`, `send_task`, `send_task_by_skill`, `get_task_status`, `get_agent_card`, `list_connected_peers`, `get_node_info`.

## MCP Bridging

```python
from agentanycast import MCPTool, mcp_tool_to_skill, skill_to_mcp_tool, mcp_tools_to_agent_card

tool = MCPTool(name="get_weather", description="Get weather", input_schema={"type": "object"})
skill = mcp_tool_to_skill(tool)
tool = skill_to_mcp_tool(skill)
card = mcp_tools_to_agent_card("WeatherServer", [tool1, tool2], description="Weather tools")
```

## DID Identity

```python
from agentanycast import peer_id_to_did_key, did_key_to_peer_id

did = peer_id_to_did_key("<peer-id>")
peer_id = did_key_to_peer_id("did:key:z6Mk...")
```

## Key Concepts

- **Dashboard**: web UI for task dispatch, agent status, and Kanban boards
- **Staff roster**: 83 specialized agents with configurable model sets
- **Kanban routing**: task boards with assignees, statuses, and A2A correlation
- **Pool dispatch**: offline queuing with automatic wake attempts for unreachable agents
- **Sidecar daemon**: Go binary auto-downloaded on first run; SDK communicates via gRPC over Unix socket
- **AgentCard**: A2A-standard agent identity with name, skills, and P2P extensions
- **Noise_XX**: all peer connections are end-to-end encrypted; no plaintext transport path
